ooe_rcu_issue_payload.lead_done_row.by: DA rev 116 (13 RCU / 0 OOE, re:RI-26; RA rev 129, AR 337, TI rev 399)
ooe_rcu_issue_payload.lead_done_row.why: RCU's in-side 13 on the zero-cycle issue end's lead_done_row, every slot (RA-43): OOE drives it from its lead flop, wire only, required 0 on OOE's side (0 + 13 <= 25). It reaches rcu_isd's class flops (ldrw_cr01h carries it). Only the four class-word lead fields take 13; every other lead field and the payload stay at 12.
